ABIS is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Technical Document Controller to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining all technical documents related to projects, ensuring that documentation is accurate, up-to-date, and easily accessible to relevant stakeholders. You will coordinate with engineering, project management, and other departments to facilitate efficient document flow and compliance with company and client standards. Your role is crucial in supporting smooth project execution and maintaining proper records for audit and reference purposes.

  

### Responsibilities

* Receive, register, and distribute technical documents according to the company’s document control procedures.
* Maintain the document management system, ensuring all files are correctly archived and easily retrievable.
* Coordinate with project teams to ensure timely submission and approval of documents.
* Ensure compliance with project and client documentation standards.
* Prepare and maintain document logs, status reports, and distribution lists.
* Assist in audits and inspections related to document control processes.
* Provide training and support on document control procedures to team members as needed.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or relevant, Engineering,
* Proven experience as a Document Controller or similar role, preferably in engineering or construction projects.
* Familiarity with document management systems (DMS) and software such or equivalent.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to handle confidential information.
* Proficient in MS Office suite.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Knowledge of relevant industry standards and procedures is a plus.

Key responsibilities include identifying potential clients, conducting market research, preparing proposals, negotiating contracts, and maintaining strong client relationships to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.

**Requirements**

* Western Region experience as BD/Sales for Industrial Services like ARAMCO/SABIC.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in business development, preferably within the oil & gas or related industries.
* Proven track record of securing new business and developing strong client relationships.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Knowledge of the Western region market and industry trends is preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.

In this key position, you will be responsible for overseeing the reporting activities related to our rail projects, ensuring accurate data collection, analysis, and presentation to support strategic decision-making. This role requires a strong understanding of the rail industry, excellent analytical capabilities, and the ability to manage complex reporting systems.

  

### Key Responsibilities:

* Lead the development, management, and delivery of comprehensive reports for rail projects.
* Collaborate with project teams to identify reporting requirements and data sources specific to rail operations.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all reporting outputs.
* Analyze rail project data to provide insights and inform project performance and risk management.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and visualization tools to support stakeholder engagement.
* Coordinate reporting activities across multiple teams and external partners as necessary.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry standards and best practices in railway reporting and data management.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Transport, or a related field.
* Total of 18 years experience in reporting or project management within the rail sector.
* Demonstrated expertise in data analysis and reporting tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
* Strong understanding of rail industry operations, standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deliver reports under tight deadlines.
* Previous experience in managing or contributing to large-scale rail infrastructure projects preferred.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Opportunity to work in a dynamic and growing organization.
* Make a real impact on Jasara's cybersecurity posture
* Be part of a collaborative and supportive team

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for supporting daily warehouse operations, ensuring accurate handling of incoming and outgoing goods, and maintaining precise inventory records. The role requires strong system knowledge, particularly in material control platforms such as Oracle and SMACC, along with a high level of attention to detail in data entry and stock management.

* Receive, inspect, and verify all incoming deliveries against purchase orders and invoices.

* Ensure proper storage, labeling, and organization of all warehouse items.
* Manage and track outgoing goods, ensuring correct dispatch quantities and documentation.
* Maintain real-time inventory accuracy across systems and physical stock.
* Perform regular stock counts and assist in inventory audits.
* Coordinate with procurement and operations teams to ensure smooth flow of goods.
* Monitor stock levels and report discrepancies, damages, or shortages.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and hygiene regulations.
* Maintain organized records of all transactions and warehouse documentation.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in warehouse operations within the F&B or retail industry.

* Hands-on experience with **Oracle Material Control** and **SMACC systems**.
* Strong data entry and inventory management skills.
* Good understanding of supply chain and stock control processes.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
* Basic computer skills (MS Office, especially Excel).
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Experience in handling food and beverage inventory.
* Familiarity with warehouse health & safety standards.
* Ability to identify process improvements in inventory handling.

JASARA PMC invites expressions of interest (EOI) for the position of Risk Manager specializing in mixed-use developments. The successful candidate will leverage their extensive experience to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with complex mixed-use projects, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and compliance with regulatory standards.

  

### Key Responsibilities

* Lead risk management activities specifically for mixed-use development projects.
* Develop and implement comprehensive risk management frameworks tailored to the unique challenges of mixed-use environments.
* Conduct detailed risk assessments and analyses throughout all project phases.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate risk mitigation strategies into project planning and execution.
* Maintain and update risk registers, dashboards, and reports to monitor risk status and trends.
* Facilitate risk workshops and training sessions to promote a proactive risk management culture.
* Provide insightful risk management reports and recommendations to senior leadership and stakeholders.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Engineering, Urban Planning, Project Management, or related discipline.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in risk management, with significant exposure to mixed-use projects.
* Proven ability to manage risk in complex, multi-disciplinary environments.
* Strong knowledge of risk management methodologies, tools, and software.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Relevant professional certifications such as PMI-RMP, CRM, or equivalent are preferred.
* Experience working within the Middle East region is advantageous.

ABIS is looking for a skilled Crane Operator to join our operations team. The Crane Operator will be responsible for operating cranes safely and efficiently to lift, move, and position materials and equipment on construction and industrial sites. This position requires expertise in crane operation, adherence to safety protocols, and effective communication with site personnel to ensure smooth workflow and prevent accidents.

### Responsibilities

* Operate cranes to lift, move, and place materials according to project requirements.
* Perform pre-operational checks and routine maintenance of crane equipment.
* Follow all safety guidelines and procedures to prevent incidents and ensure site safety.
* Coordinate with riggers, signal persons, and site supervisors during lifting operations.
* Maintain accurate logs of crane operation activities and maintenance records.
* Report equipment malfunctions or hazards to the maintenance team promptly.

**Requirements**

* Valid crane operator certification or license. / SAUDI License preferred
* Proven experience as a crane operator in construction, oil & gas, or industrial environments.
* Strong knowledge of crane operation safety standards and maintenance procedures.
* Ability to work at heights and in various weather conditions.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to adhering to safety protocols.

ABIS is seeking a skilled Coating Engineer to join our Oil & Gas industry team. The Coating Engineer will be responsible for developing, planning, and supervising coating projects to ensure the protection of equipment and structures against corrosion and other environmental factors. This role involves close collaboration with project teams to specify coatings, manage application processes, and ensure compliance with industry standards and client requirements. The ideal candidate will have a strong engineering background, extensive knowledge of coating systems and materials, and a commitment to quality and safety.

  

### Responsibilities

* Develop coating specifications and procedures for oil and gas projects.
* Inspect and evaluate surfaces to determine appropriate coating systems.
* Supervise coating application activities to ensure compliance with standards and specifications.
* Coordinate with quality control and inspection teams to monitor coating integrity.
* Manage documentation related to coating processes, approvals, and certifications.
* Provide technical support and recommendations for coating-related issues.
* Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental regulations during coating operations.
* Stay updated with latest technologies and industry trends in coatings and corrosion protection.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, or Corrosion Engineering or related field.
* Minimum 5 years experience in coating engineering within the oil and gas industry.
* In-depth knowledge of coating materials, surface preparation, and application techniques.
* Familiarity with industry standards such as NACE, SSPC, and ISO related to coating and corrosion control.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.
* Proficiency in relevant software tools for documentation and reporting.
* Commitment to safety and quality standards in all activities.

This is a vital role within a fast-paced production environment, where you will be responsible for ensuring that heavy-duty components and finished products are moved safely and efficiently to keep manufacturing lines running smoothly.

The ideal candidate will be a proactive professional who takes pride in maintaining an organized workspace and prioritizing safety. If you have experience navigating a manufacturing warehouse and possess strong attention to detail, we want to hear from you.

* Operate forklifts and other material-handling equipment to move heavy generator parts and finished goods throughout the facility.
* Load and unload incoming shipments of raw materials and outgoing deliveries of completed units.
* Perform regular inventory counts and assist with stock replenishment to prevent production delays.
* Organize warehouse layouts to optimize space and ensure easy access to critical manufacturing components.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and orderly warehouse environment in compliance with all safety regulations.
* Assist with order picking, packing, and preparing documentation for outgoing shipments.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience as a Forklift Operator or Warehouse Assistant (manufacturing background is a plus).
* Valid Forklift Certification/License.
* Ability to safely handle heavy, bulky, and high-value equipment.
* Strong physical stamina and the ability to perform manual lifting tasks as required.
* A high level of attention to detail and accuracy in inventory management.
* A proactive attitude toward workplace safety and teamwork.

We are seeking a MEP Manager Architecture to join JASARA PMC. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will be responsible for managing specific design and review processes during the various stages from conceptualization to execution, while adhering to client requirements and company standards. The role will be instrumental in collaborating with commercial, project management, engineering and design technical leaders to create opportunities for efficiency and innovation. The role is responsible for maintaining compliance with QA/QC procedures, including the deliverables review QA/QC process.

### Responsibilities

* Lead and manage the entire design process for all mechanical and plumbing services, district cooling, firefighting and gas services for the entire design and construction process from start to finish.
* Collaborate closely with our development teams (architects and engineers), clients, contractors and stakeholders to fully understand project requirements and create innovative design solutions that satisfy client requirements and fully satisfies local codes and standards.
* Ensure smooth coordination with internal and external design teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality design documents and drawings, while making sure adherence to project timelines, budgets and meet our clients’ high-quality standards.
* Conduct regular design review meetings where you will provide technical guidance and support to our clients, consultants, contractors and team members.
* Proactively monitor and track project progress, promptly identify and resolve any design-related challenges or conflicts that may arise and report timeously on these.
* Efficiently manage and maintain meticulous project documentation, including design records, change orders, and necessary approvals.
* Maintain strict compliance with industry standards, codes, and regulations to guarantee the success of each project.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, consultants, contractors and stakeholders to ensure effective coordination and integration of various design elements to achieve seamless progression from design, construction to final handover.
* Compilation and presentation of reports and visual presentations regarding designs, design reviews, cost analysis and progress on project tasks.
* Setup and chair meetings with the client, consultants, design team and stakeholders whilst capturing minutes of meetings as necessary.
* Comply with QIC (Qiddiya Investment Company) governance requirements.
* Oversee and manage all project interfaces within the delivery program.
* Prepare and present design reports, presentations, and recommendations to stakeholders.

**Requirements**

* A 4-year bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering is necessary.
* An engineering master’s degree is desirable.
* Registration as a chartered mechanical engineer is necessary (or similar).
* Must have a minimum of 10-years engineering experience of all mechanical (HVAC) and plumbing services, district cooling, firefighting and gas services regarding the design, detailed review, documentation, specifications, project management and staff coordination.
* Experience in the design and coordinating of electrical systems is an advantage.
* We expect you to possess a strong knowledge of design principles and analysis, techniques, and best practices related to mechanical and plumbing services, district cooling and gas services.
* Experience in construction oversight of the infrastructure described above.
* Proficiency in using engineering design software and related tools is necessary.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects on time and within budget is necessary.
* Your experience in coordinating and executing design activities, managing design consultants, engaging with stakeholders and coordinating design team members is crucial for this role.
* Strong leadership and management skills with the ability to effectively lead and motivate a team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are essential, as you will be expected to collaborate effectively with our clients, consultants, contractors, multi-disciplinary teams and stakeholders.
* Your strong problem-solving and analytical skills, coupled with attention to detail, will be invaluable for this position.
* You should be able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines with the ability to multi-task and prioritize your workload in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.
* Knowledge of both relevant industry and local standards, codes and regulations.

ABIS is seeking a qualified Rigger Level 1 with Saudi Aramco approval to support lifting and rigging operations at various project sites. This position demands a strong understanding of rigging techniques, tools, and safety standards, as well as compliance with Saudi Aramco regulations and requirements.

### Responsibilities

* Inspect, assemble, and dismantle rigging equipment according to job requirements and safety standards.
* Assist crane operators in securing and moving loads safely and efficiently.
* Ensure that all rigging operations comply with Saudi Aramco standards and company safety policies.
* Conduct pre-lift inspections and report any hazards or equipment issues promptly.
* Maintain proper documentation of rigging activities and inspections.
* Collaborate with other team members to complete tasks safely and effectively.

* Proven experience as a rigger in construction, oil and gas, or industrial settings.
* Strong knowledge of rigging equipment, techniques, and safety regulations.
* Ability to work at heights and handle physically demanding tasks.
* Good communication skills and ability to follow instructions carefully.
* Commitment to safety and adherence to Saudi Aramco and company standards.

ABIS is seeking a qualified Breathing Apparatus / Nitrogen - BA/N2 Technician to manage and maintain breathing apparatus and nitrogen equipment to ensure safety compliance on site. The technician will be responsible for the inspection, testing, maintenance, and repair of breathing apparatus and nitrogen systems used in hazardous environments, particularly within the oil and gas industry. The role requires strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, and adherence to strict safety standards. The ideal candidate will work closely with health and safety teams to support safe operations and emergency preparedness.

### Responsibilities

* Perform regular inspection, testing, maintenance, and repair of breathing apparatus and nitrogen equipment.
* Ensure all BA and nitrogen systems comply with safety regulations and industry standards.
* Conduct equipment calibration and troubleshooting to maintain operational readiness.
* Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, inspections, and equipment status.
* Provide support during emergency drills and real incidents by preparing and supplying breathing apparatus and nitrogen systems.
* Coordinate with safety and operational teams to ensure compliance and safe work environments.
* Train personnel in the correct use and care of breathing apparatus and nitrogen systems.

* Technical diploma or certification in relevant fields such as safety equipment maintenance, mechanical or electrical.
* Previous experience working with breathing apparatus and nitrogen systems, preferably in oil and gas or industrial settings.
* Knowledge of safety standards and regulations related to breathing apparatus and compressed gases.
* Ability to perform troubleshooting, repairs, and routine maintenance accurately.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety.
* Good communication skills and ability to work effectively within a team.
* Willingness to work in challenging and potentially hazardous environments.

This role requires strict adherence to safety protocols and effective communication with onsite personnel to ensure smooth and secure operations.

* Perform pre-operational checks and routine maintenance on manlift equipment.
* Ensure all safety guidelines and protocols are strictly followed during operations.
* Coordinate with site supervisors and workers to plan safe maneuvering and positioning.
* Report any equipment malfunctions or safety concerns promptly.

description:

We act for trade.

As a global leading player in trade credit risk management, we support the growth of 100,000 clients across some 200 markets.

Whatever their size, location or sector, we offer companies a full range of solutions: Trade Credit Insurance, Business Information, Debt Collection, Single Risk insurance, Surety Bonds, Factoring.

Every day, we leverage our unique expertise and cutting-edge technology to make trade happen, in both domestic and export markets.

**Commitments**

**Diversity, equity, and inclusion**

Coface is fully committed to creating a work atmosphere that respects the individualities and diversity of its teams. Given the nature of its business, which operates across a global scope, Coface must remain a multicultural company. To that end, employees must benefit from an inclusive and non-discriminatory work environment. This allows for collaborative and fruitful work between teams representing 80 nationalities and working in 58 countries.

Coface has been focusing in particular on gender equity and gender balance in career opportunities, and diversity in senior management roles. Coface has initiated numerous actions plans in that field, together with indicators for monitoring progress.

Accordingly, diversity and inclusion are a key component of the Group Human Resources strategy. Coface work environment must be seen as inclusive and the company as a place where employees can thrive and contribute their authenticity to their professional activities.

To that end, Coface has introduced training and awareness-raising initiatives to encourage the transformation of the corporate culture towards greater openness to diversity.… more

**Career growth and learning**

At Coface, we strive to establish and develop a lasting relationship of trust, encouraging integration, and supporting professional development; these are our priorities and commitments.

We have a dedicated program called “Move & Grow” to boost internal mobility. In fact, we believe in internal mobility as an accelerator of career growth, as much as a fantastic opportunity to learn and grow from a more personal standpoint. We encourage you to seize every opportunity to get out of your comfort zone, by changing jobs and taking on new responsibilities.

In parallel, we have a program dedicated to new comers, which provides access to all the information necessary for integration and allows them to follow a path marked out by individual meetings, immersive experiences, training and informal sharing moments. We also have mentoring programs and much more to support your career development.

description:
### About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.

### Why This Role Matters

We are building something new at Lucidya - an Inside Sales function designed to move fast, win often, and reach a wider market.

While our Enterprise team navigates complex, long-horizon deals, the Inside Sales team is built for speed. You will target mid-sized organisations across industries that are ready to act now - companies that need a modern CX intelligence platform and don't have 6 months to evaluate one.

As an Inside Sales Account Executive, you won't be waiting for leads to warm up. You'll be building your pipeline, running your own cycles, and closing deals within 30 to 60 days. 90% of your focus will be on **outbound** reaches.

This role is an **on-site role**, based in our office in Riyadh, KSA.

If you have a track record of closing deals without a physical presence, and want to own something - your numbers, your process, your results - this is where you do it.

### What You Will Do

* Own and hit your yearly and quarterly revenue targets - pipeline health is your responsibility, not your manager's.
* Run high-velocity, full-cycle sales from first outreach to signed contract, typically within 30 to 60 days.
* Identify and pursue mid-market accounts across different sectors that stand to gain from Lucidya's CX intelligence capabilities.
* Lead discovery conversations that uncover real business pain, not just surface-level interest - you sell solutions, not features.
* Demo the product with confidence and adapt your pitch to speak to what actually matters to each buyer.
* Work closely with SDRs to ensure a steady flow of quality meetings and provide feedback that sharpens their targeting and qualification.
* Forecast accurately and maintain a clean, up-to-date CRM - you know where every deal stands and why.
* Handle objections head-on and navigate procurement, legal, and stakeholder friction without losing momentum.
* Collaborate with Customer Success on handovers that set clients up for a strong start.
* Stay sharp on the market, competitors, and evolving customer expectations.

### Who You Are

* You have 3 to 5 years of experience in SaaS or technology sales, with a track record of consistently hitting quota.
* You thrive in a fast-moving environment. Short sales cycles energise you - you like building momentum, not waiting for it.
* You are self-sufficient. You don't need a fully built playbook to perform; you can create structure where there isn't one.
* You communicate clearly and credibly with business decision-makers - department heads, operations leaders, and executives at growing companies.
* You are commercially aware. You understand deal economics, discount dynamics, and how to close without giving everything away.
* You are organised and consistent. Your pipeline is real, your forecasts are reliable, and your follow-ups happen without being asked.
* You know how to partner with SDRs - you give them honest feedback, treat them as teammates, and help them get better.
* Experience in CX, analytics, social listening, or AI-based platforms is a strong plus.

**Culturally, you are**:

* Driven by results, not activity.
* Resilient when deals don't close - you learn and move forward.
* Honest with yourself about what's working and what isn't.
* Excited to be part of something that's being built, not just maintained.

### What the process will look like:

* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Technical Interview with Head of Inside Sales
* Case study presentation
* Culture fit call
* Offer

### About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.

### Why This Role Matters

Organizations across industries and segments are no longer asking whether to deploy AI in their customer operations, they are asking which partner to trust with that transformation. Lucidya's Agentic AI platform sits at the centre of that question.

This role is the commercial front line of that shift. You will be selling autonomous AI agents that handle real customer interactions at scale, deflect tier-1 contact centre volume, and continuously learn from every conversation. This is not a tooling conversation. It is a business transformation conversation.

You will work with CX leaders, COOs, and digital transformation heads at some of the region's largest organizations. You will navigate long, complex enterprise cycles, build airtight business cases, and own the commercial outcome end to end.

If you have sold into contact centres before, understand what AHT, FCR, and deflection rate mean in a boardroom, and know how to handle the "will this replace my team?" objection without flinching - this role is for you.

### What You Will Do

**Revenue & Pipeline Ownership**

* Own enterprise and government ARR targets and drive meaningful, predictable revenue growth quarter over quarter
* Build and manage a high quality pipeline. You obsess over deal progression and forecast accuracy, not just volume
* Map every account strategically: decision makers, influencers, blockers, budget owners, timing, and internal politics

**Agentic AI Sales Execution**

* Run full sales cycles end-to-end: discovery, business case, pilot scoping, executive alignment, negotiation, and close
* Lead value based conversations with C-suite stakeholders, not product demos. Translate autonomous AI capabilities into hard business outcomes such as: cost per contact reduction, deflection rate improvement, CSAT uplift, headcount efficiency,etc.
* Sell the transformation story confidently: how AI Agents change the operating model of a contact centre, not just automate a workflow or a chat agent.
* Handle the "will this replace my team?" objection head-on. You have been through this conversation many times and have a clean, credible answer.

**Pilot Leadership**

* Scope pilots like a consultant. Define success metrics with the customer upfront and hold the line on them throughout.
* Build business cases in real time. You can open a spreadsheet in front of a CX director and show: "If you deflect 30% of tier-1 tickets at your current volume, here is your payback in months."
* Own the pilot outcome. You do not hand off to Customer Success, you stay accountable until the customer sees measurable value.

**Market & Stakeholder Development**

* Develop and maintain executive relationships across your target accounts, becoming a trusted advisor.
* Partner closely with Solution Consultants, Product and Customer Support to ensure smooth handovers, technically credible demos, and successful customer onboarding.
* Continuously sharpen your understanding of the Agentic AI landscape, competitive positioning, and CX technology trends.
* Leverage and grow your network within Saudi and GCC organizations to accelerate pipeline development.

### What we are looking for

* Someone with 6-12 years of experience with at least 2–5 of those selling to CX/contact center buyers.
* Have sold to CX and contact centre buyers. Understands what AHT, FCR, CSAT, deflection rate, cost-per-contact, agent utilisation, and shrinkage mean.
* Came from a CCaaS, conversational AI, or CX software vendor. Preferably: Genesys, NICE, Zendesk, Freshworks, Kore.ai, Cognigy, Ada, Intercom, Talkdesk, Avaya, Unifonic. Experience in selling automation or bots specifically is a strong advantage.
* Has a consultative mindset and an ROI-led seller; not a transactional closer. Our AI Agent is a 6-to-9-month enterprise cycle with a business case, a pilot, an integration conversation, and a change-management story. You build deals; you don't work inbound queues.
* An Arabic-native with deep Saudi/GCC market fluency. You understand how to navigate procurement in a Saudi bank, a telco, or a government entity - including Nafath, PDPL compliance, and the internal politics that determine whether a deal closes. This is non-negotiable for our ICP.

**Core Competencies & Experience**

* Navigating AI's Impact: You have a track record of selling solutions that result in human-resource efficiency. You are adept at managing the political sensitivity of AI-driven headcount changes and can deliver a credible, compassionate response to concerns.
* Pioneering a New Category (Agentic AI): As Agentic AI is an emerging category, a significant part of the sales process involves buyer education and de-risking the pilot phase. You are skilled at opening doors and building momentum without a full repository of established case studies.
* Consultative Pilot Management: You are comfortable with a reference-thin pitch and can run a pilot like a consultant. This includes independently scoping the project, defining clear success metrics, and maintaining direct accountability for achieving them—you do not merely hand off the project and wait for results.
* Financial Acumen: Commercial and business excellence are your strengths. You can proficiently construct a live business case with the customer, modeling key metrics such as volume, deflection rate, cost-per-contact, and payback period (e.g., using Excel).  
    

**Attitude & Approach**

* Proactive & Prepared: You are proactive by default, consistently following up without prompting and preparing thoroughly for every meeting. You anticipate objections and ensure you walk into discussions with answers ready.
* Team-Oriented & Problem-Solver: You are highly collaborative internally. Your focus is on problem-solving, not blaming other departments (Product, Marketing, or Customer Support) for challenges.

### Culturally

You thrive in fast-scaling environments where structure evolves. You are comfortable being the expert in the room in a category that many buyers are still learning about. You get energy from complexity, not comfort.

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.

Our Enterprise Sales team works with some of the largest organisations in the region - major banks, telecoms, retailers, etc.. These are high-stakes, high-value deals that shape how entire industries understand and engage their customers.

This role puts you at the front of that.

As an SDR on the Enterprise team, you won't be warming up in the background. You will be researching and engaging the kinds of organisations that most people spend years trying to get a meeting with. You will learn how enterprise sales actually works - the strategy, the stakeholders, the craft - from people who do it at the highest level.

We are not looking for experience. We are looking for the person who is going to outwork, out-prepare, and out-think everyone else in the room. The ceiling for the right person in this role is very high - our Enterprise AEs are among the top performers at Lucidya, and this is how that journey starts.

If you are serious about building a career in sales and want to learn from some of the best in the game - this is the right opportunity for you.

### What You Will Do

* Research enterprise target accounts and identify the right contacts within large, complex organisations
* Execute outbound prospecting via email, phone, and LinkedIn - with messaging that is sharp, relevant, and tailored to each account
* Qualify prospects and convert them into booked meetings for our Enterprise Account Executives

* Share market feedback with the team - what's landing, what objections are coming up, and what needs to change

You are responsible for outcomes: qualified meetings, pipeline created, and the quality of what you pass to the AEs.

### Who You Are

* A recent graduate - your degree doesn’t matter as much, however you are a top performer in your field
* Fluent in Arabic and proficient in English - you will be engaging senior stakeholders in both
* Naturally curious. You like understanding how large organisations work, what drives their decisions, and where a solution genuinely fits

* Organised and consistent. You follow through without being reminded and don't let warm leads go cold
* You have high attention to detail and are extremely punctual

* Hungry. You want to be exceptional at this, and you're willing to do what it takes to get there
* Accountable. You own your numbers and don't make excuses
* Coachable. You listen, apply feedback quickly, and improve fast
* Resilient. A difficult week doesn't break your momentum - you have a track record of picking yourself back up and soldiering on

The Senior Handover & Commissioning Engineer is a fully qualified professional with deep expertise in Testing & Commissioning (T&C), construction close-out, and asset handover across multi-disciplinary infrastructure systems including roads, structures, utilities, landscape, power, and Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS).

This role focuses on governance, coordination, and assurance of handover readiness, ensuring all contractual, technical, and stakeholder requirements are met prior to Substantial Completion and Final Handover.     * O&M Manuals and Training Documentation
    * Warranties, Guarantees, and Spare Parts
    * Testing & Commissioning Reports
    * Asset Registers and GIS submissions (where applicable)
* Manages and tracks Substantial Completion requirements, including approval-gated items such as:
    * Construction Acceptance Tests
    * Closed Snag Lists
    * Operation & Maintenance Manuals
    * Road Safety Audits and operational readiness evidence
* Coordinates with stakeholders and authorities (e.g., municipality, utility providers, traffic control entities) to secure handover approvals, permits, and clearances.
* Ensures proper interface management between systems (e.g., power supply to ITS, drainage integration, traffic signal operations).
* Reviews contractor submissions including method statements, T&C plans, ITPs, and close-out documentation.
* Monitors contractor and PMCM performance on handover readiness, highlighting risks and enforcing corrective actions.
* Supports the definition and implementation of Defect Liability Period (DLP) strategies and handover conditions.
* Advises PMO leadership on handover risks, partial completions, and operational readiness.
* Provides technical leadership and guidance on commissioning and handover matters across all disciplines.
* Performs other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or related discipline).
* Member of Saudi Council of Engineers
* Typically 10+ years of experience, with significant exposure to infrastructure projects and handover/commissioning phases in Saudi Arabia
* Experience in PMO or client-side roles on large-scale or megaprojects is preferred.
* Familiarity with local Saudi regulations, authorities, and handover processes is highly desirable.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Strong knowledge of Testing & Commissioning processes across multi-disciplinary infrastructure systems.
* Proven experience in handover management, close-out documentation, and stakeholder coordination.
* Ability to manage complex interfaces between utilities, ITS, and civil infrastructure.
* Familiarity with GIS/asset management systems and digital handover requirements.
* Excellent analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Proficiency in PMO systems and document control platforms (e.g., Aconex, PMWeb, Unifier).
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities across a program environment.

## **Job summary:**

We are seeking highly skilled and adaptable **B1.3 (Mechanical)** Licensed Engineers to join our mobile support team. This is not a hangar-bound role; you will be the front-line technical expert supporting customer operations across the **Africa and Middle East (AME)** region.

You will ensure the highest standards of safety and availability for heavy twin-engine helicopters operating in diverse and often challenging environments.

## **Primary Responsibilities:**

* **Maintenance Execution:** Perform scheduled (Base/Line) and unscheduled maintenance, troubleshooting, and defect rectification on H225, Caracal, and Super Puma families.
    
* **Field Support:** Deploy on short-notice, punctual missions to customer sites to provide technical assistance, AOG (Aircraft On Ground) support, and specialized repairs.
    
* **Compliance:** Certify all work performed in accordance with EASA Part 145 standards (or equivalent local CAA regulations) and company Quality Management Systems.
    
* **Customer Liaison:** Act as a technical ambassador, providing guidance to customer maintenance teams and ensuring operational continuity.
    
* **Safety & Quality:** Maintain a "Safety First" culture, ensuring all tooling, parts, and procedures meet rigorous aviation standards.
    

## **Required Qualifications & Skills:**

**Licensing:** Valid EASA Part 66 B1.3 License (or equivalent).

**Type Ratings** **Mandatory :** Current Type Ratings on H225 (EC225LP) and/or AS332 (L1, L2, C1).

**Experience:** Minimum 5+ years of hands-on maintenance experience on the specified types.

**Mobility:** High flexibility for frequent travel and short-term assignments across Africa & the Middle East.

**Language:** Proficiency in English (Technical and Spoken). French is a significant advantage for West African operations.

Open for mobilization for deployment in Africa & Middle east countries for short missions.

## **The "Plus" Factors:**

* Additional Type Ratings on other Airbus Helicopters (e.g., H145, H135, or AS365/H155).
    
* Experience with military variants (Caracal/Cougar) and mission-specific equipment.
    
* Proven ability to work independently in remote or austere environments.
    

## **Personal Profile:**

* **Resilient:** You thrive in high-pressure environments and can solve complex technical problems with limited local infrastructure.
    
* **Adaptable:** You are culturally sensitive and comfortable moving between different countries and customer environments.
    
* **Autonomous:** You have a "can-do" attitude and the ability to make sound technical decisions in the field.

description:
****Job Description:****

## **Job summary:**

We are seeking highly skilled and adaptable **B2 (Avionics)** Licensed Engineers to join our mobile support team. This is not a hangar-bound role; you will be the front-line technical expert supporting customer operations across the **Africa and Middle East (AME)** region.

You will ensure the highest standards of safety and availability for heavy twin-engine helicopters operating in diverse and often challenging environments.

## **Primary Responsibilities**

* **Maintenance Execution:** Perform scheduled (Base/Line) and unscheduled maintenance, troubleshooting, and defect rectification on H225, Caracal, and Super Puma families.
    
* **Field Support:** Deploy on short-notice, punctual missions to customer sites to provide technical assistance, AOG (Aircraft On Ground) support, and specialized repairs.
    
* **Compliance:** Certify all work performed in accordance with EASA Part 145 standards (or equivalent local CAA regulations) and company Quality Management Systems.
    
* **Customer Liaison:** Act as a technical ambassador, providing guidance to customer maintenance teams and ensuring operational continuity.
    
* **Safety & Quality:** Maintain a "Safety First" culture, ensuring all tooling, parts, and procedures meet rigorous aviation standards.
    

## **Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Licensing:** Valid EASA B2 License (or equivalent).

**Type Ratings** **Mandatory:** Current Type Ratings on H225 (EC225LP) and/or AS332 (L1, L2, C1).

**Experience:** Minimum 5+ years of hands-on maintenance experience on the specified types.

**Mobility:** High flexibility for frequent travel and short-term assignments across Africa & the Middle East.

**Language:** Proficiency in English (Technical and Spoken). French is a significant advantage for West African operations.

Open for mobilization and deployment to Africa & middle east countries for short missions.

**The "Plus" Factors:**

* Additional Type Ratings on other Airbus Helicopters (e.g., H145, H135, or AS365/H155).
    
* Experience with military variants (Caracal/Cougar) and mission-specific equipment.
    
* Proven ability to work independently in remote or austere environments.
    

## **Personal Profile:**

* **Resilient:** You thrive in high-pressure environments and can solve complex technical problems with limited local infrastructure.
    
* **Adaptable:** You are culturally sensitive and comfortable moving between different countries and customer environments.
    
* **Autonomous:** You have a "can-do" attitude and the ability to make sound technical decisions in the field.

With a global presence across Europe, North America, and the Middle East, our diverse and growing team supports leading organizations on complex and high-impact programs.

We are currently looking for a Senior HR Advisor to join our Riyadh office on a 12 month fixed-term contract.  A strategic, hands-on and collaborative HR to support our growing business in Saudi Arabia. This is an opportunity to become a trusted adviser to senior leaders, managers and employees, and to turn business priorities into practical, people-focused solutions. You will combine strategic business partnering with hands-on delivery across employee relations, performance, organisational change, HR operations, government compliance, Saudi employment law and employee experience. The role is based in Riyadh, and the Senior Advisor is expected in the office three days per week.

**As Senior HR Advisor, you will:**

**Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management:**

* Build trusted relationships with leaders, managers and employees in Saudi Arabia, acting as their first point of contact for people matters.
* Translate business plans, workforce needs, organisational risks and local regulatory requirements, including Saudization requirements, into clear, practical people plans.
* Coach managers through team dynamics, feedback, employee development and sensitive conversations.

**Employee Relations & Compliance:**

* Manage employee relations matters with sound judgement, appropriate documentation, confidentiality and consistency.
* Provide practical guidance on Saudi Labour Law, its Implementing Regulations, relevant Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development requirements, company policy and HR best practice; engage Legal or external counsel where needed.
* Support managers on performance, conduct, probation, grievance, leave and workplace-support matters.

**HR Operations & Government Compliance:**

* Own end-to-end HR operations, including onboarding and offboarding administration, employee contracts and documentation, background checks, absence and leave administration, and employee requests, letters and employment or salary verifications.
* Manage Qiwa and GOSI requirements, including employee registration, government portal actions and other compliance matters.
* Coordinate payroll-related HR administration with Finance and relevant payroll providers, ensuring accurate and timely employee data and documentation.
* Maintain HRIS records and employee data, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality and compliance with local requirements.
* Take ownership of these activities and ensure required actions are completed, working in coordination with our GRO, where relevant.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, Finance and the global People team on workforce planning, talent, reward and organisational change initiatives.
* Use people data and employee feedback to identify trends, mitigate risks and improve the employee experience.
* Contribute to scalable policies, processes, manager guidance and local engagement initiatives across the Saudi Arabia business.

**We’re looking for someone who has:**

* At least 4 years of progressive HR experience, ideally in an HR Business Partner or HR Generalist role with significant business-partnering responsibility.
* Hands-on experience using Saudi government platforms, particularly Qiwa and GOSI, with the ability to manage related employee registration and compliance actions independently.
* Working knowledge of Saudi employment law, its Implementing Regulations, local employment requirements and Saudization programmes, with the judgement to identify risk and seek specialist advice when appropriate.
* Experience managing employee relations and advising managers on performance and sensitive people matters.
* Strong stakeholder-management, coaching and communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment and balancing strategic priorities with hands-on operational delivery.
* Strong analytical skills and confidence using HRIS and people data.
* Discreet, proactive and highly organised, with the ability to handle sensitive information appropriately.
* Is fluent in both Arabic and English (written and spoken)

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The periodontist provides direct outpatient care in all areas of periodontics and general dentistry in consultation with dental specialist, physicians and other health professionals as required for the best interest of the patient.

Patient Examination and Evaluation:

Examines clinically and radiographically the hard and soft tissues of the oral cavity and head and neck region.

Identifies and records developmental abnormalities, caries, fractures, root exposures, erosions, abrasions, and defective restorations of existing teeth. Records condition and existing pathology of the periodontium, and other soft tissues of the mouth, temporo-mandibular joint, muscles of mastication, occlusal relationship, and other areas of the head and neck region.

Orders, exposes, and interprets intra oral radiographs of the teeth and alveolar ridges. Uses radiography techniques and safeguards which will assure maximum diagnostic results and patient protection against radiation hazards.

Diagnoses existing pathology of the above mentioned areas utilizing other aids such as study casts, electric vitalometers, transillumunators, thermal aids, percussion and palpation.

Interviews patients and records medical history. Order appropriate medical laboratory tests to assist in the diagnosis of systemic diseases which may affect the course of dental treatment.

Plans a course of treatment based on the findings of the clinical and radiographic examination, the patient's needs and consistent with the philosophy and policies guiding the delivery of dental health care in the clinic.

Patient Education and Management:

Ascertains patient's interest in dental health care, treatment expectations, as well as availability, and when applicable, explains all aspects of dental disease, planned treatment, and costs as required to assure complete understanding on the part of the patient.

Performs preventive procedures on adult including; dietary analysis, caries susceptibility tests, prophylaxis, topical fluoride therapy, oral hygiene instructions and application of dental fissure sealants.

Prescribes and administers pre-medications to patients as indicated and utilizes local anesthetics for control of pain. Recognizes adverse reactions to these agents and takes immediate necessary measures to counteract such reactions.

Patient Treatment:

The primary responsibilities of a periodontist are to prevent, diagnose and treat periodontal diseases

Diagnoses and treats inflammatory and destructive diseases of investing and supporting tissue of teeth: Cleans and polishes teeth, eliminates Irritating margins of fillings, and corrects occlusions.

Treat patients who have gum disease and other issues of the gums and Bones surrounding the jaw. Work may be surgical or non-surgical.

Non-Surgical Periodontal Treatment includes: Scaling and Root Planning, Tray Delivery Systems.

Surgical Periodontal Treatment includes:

Gummy Smile or Uneven Gum Line Long Teeth/Exposed Roots

Gum Graft Surgery: Gum graft surgery will repair the defect and help to Prevent additional recession and bone loss.

Regenerative Procedures Membranes (filters), bone grafts or tissue Stimulating proteins.

Dental Crown Lengthening

Bone graft and Dental Implants. Socket preservation ,management any type of bone quality, and soft tissue augmentation.

Periodontal Pocket Reduction Procedures.

simple extractions and suture removal to complicated sinus lifts Laser Treatment for Gum Disease.

Different cases of extraction .

Adjust occlusion as necessary to provide and acceptable pattern of centric contact

and acceptable pattern of grouped functional contacts and elimination of nonfunctional contact.

Prepare teeth and soft tissue for the placement of fixed or removable Prosthesis.

Treats and restores decayed and fractured teeth of adults under adequate isolation to remove decay, shape cavities to receive the restorative materials of choice (gold, silver, amalgam, resin, porcelain), places appropriate medications and bases to treat or protect the remaining tooth structure, places, carves finishes and polishes the restorations to restore function and appearance.

Removes diseased or fractures teeth which are beyond repair. Performs

other oral surgical procedures.

Provides emergency after hours dental services to hospital in-patient, outpatient, and emergency room referrals.

Recognizes orthodontic problems of patients. Designs, fits, and adjusts removable appliances for minor tooth movement or for space maintenance.

Recognizes and treats or refers for treatment, oral pathology, malignant and benign. Recognizes oral manifestations of systemic disease possesses a basic knowledge of general medicine.

Utilizes acceptable behavior management technique e.g. active/ passive restraint, laughing gas, oral conscious sedation and general anesthesia.

Personnel Management and Training:

Directs the work of one or more trained auxiliaries in providing dental care to patients. Performs evaluations of dental care to patients. Performs evaluation of dental assistant's work in a manner that encourages improvement, enthusiasm over good work, confidence in ability to improve. Makes suggestions for individual improvement.

Consults with dental laboratory personnel in the construction of fixed and removable space maintenance.

Professionalism

Recognizes personal limitations and refers patients to other health professionals when this referral will result in better care for the patient.

Demonstrate a commitment to the delivery of quality patient care within the bounds of the clinical environment.

Participates in an in-service training program and continuing techniques education courses to improve personal knowledge of techniques and materials and to enhance skills to meet individual or department requirements.

Performs other duties and projects as assigned by his immediate supervisor.

Provide personalized coordinated care, support and treatment for patients and families.

Treat people with dignity, compassion, and respect.

Involving patients in decisions and helping them take actions to support themselves.

Involve patients, families and caregivers by providing them with education and resources

for offering optimal support to promote recovery.

Dedicated to education of health professions students, residents and Fellow physicians

so they can work together in multidisciplinary teams to provide competent, ethical and

continuous person-centered care.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree in Dentistry.

License: Must be licensed or registered to practice dentistry in his country of origin or Saudi Arabia.

Must successfully complete a written and practical Dental Examination administered by Dental Clinic Supervisory Personnel.

3 years of post-doctorate education specific to the field of periodontics and Possibly a hospital internship.

The Material Handler is responsible for supporting line flow and shop floor execution by ensuring standard work-in-progress (STD WIP) levels are maintained, components are placed in the correct locations, and material movement aligns with production flow requirements throughout the line. This role plays a critical part in supporting production continuity, visual control, single piece flow, and adherence to standard work by helping ensure operators have the right material in the right place at the right time.  
In addition to managing material flow, this role is expected to monitor line performance against takt time and cycle time expectations, track piece movement once takt is completed, identify and escalate abnormalities, support adherence to Standard Work and Standard Work Combination Sheets, and contribute to overall Lean implementation across the line. The Material Handler is expected to be knowledgeable of the overall line process and actively engaged with each operator’s playbook to support smooth execution, process discipline, and operational performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain **STD WIP** levels across the line to support balanced flow and uninterrupted production.
* Ensure components are placed and maintained in the **correct designated locations** throughout the shop floor.
* Maintain **single piece flow** across the line to support efficient production movement and reduce excess WIP.
* Track **piece movement once takt is completed** to ensure proper part flow and timely movement between workstations.
* Monitor material flow and line status to support production readiness and process continuity.
* Highlight issues when **cycle time exceeds takt time** and communicate abnormalities that may impact line performance.
* Support and monitor line adherence to **Standard Work** and **Standard Work Combination Sheets** across the line.

* Demonstrate strong understanding and application of **Lean principles** in daily work activities.
* Identify and communicate opportunities for **continuous improvement** in flow, cycle time, waste reduction, and workplace organization.
* Contribute to problem solving and support corrective actions related to material flow, WIP control, and process interruptions.
* Work within takt time and standard process flow expectations to support production goals.
